expected_structural_delta: One descriptor closure and one focused lifecycle regression. No new lock or process owner.
minimum_design: Close inherited fd8 in the existing usage-refresh child. Exercise actual maintenance and fleet-lock functions with a blocked refresh child.
outcome: Package cache maintenance releases the fleet lock when the foreground operation finishes, while its asynchronous usage refresh may continue.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing fleet lock
reuse_decisions.rationale: Keep foreground serialization and explicitly drop only its inherited descriptor in the asynchronous child.
